input.summary: Remove the three-year take-or-pay commitment; fees payable for Services ordered/used only.
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a multi-year take-or-pay commitment with no reduction or termination right, so we have replaced § 2.1 with fees for Services actually ordered or used, consistent with §§ 7.1, 9.4 and 12.3. If a commitment is commercially necessary, we can discuss one limited to the current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days' notice with a true-up rather than a penalty.

ops.oldText: Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: Customer has no minimum purchase or take-or-pay commitment, and owes Fees only for Services ordered by Customer under an Order Form or actually used by Customer.
